events.notesGeneral:
Top ensembles of Marching Music’s Major League™ will come together for a night of dramatic, passionate and exceptional performances during Drum Corps at the Cinema: 2018 DCI Tour Premiere, broadcast LIVE in movie theatres nationwide!

This eighth-annual event will feature six of DCI’s top marching music ensembles: Blue Stars (La Crosse, WI), Bluecoats (Canton, OH), Boston Crusaders (Boston, MA), Carolina Crown (Ft. Mill, SC), The Cavaliers (Rosemont, IL), and Phantom Regiment (Rockford, IL).

After a year off and in the wake of the cancelation of the 2020 DCI Tour, Drum Corps International is set to return to Indianapolis' Lucas Oil Stadium August 12–14. Nearly two dozen corps will have the unique opportunity to showcase their performances – perhaps unlike at any other time in DCI history!

You can take part in the celebration, even if you can’t join us in-person at Lucas Oil Stadium this August! For a donation of $100 to DCI’s ongoing programs, your supplied photographic image will be reproduced as a life-size DCI Fan Cut Out that will be placed in Lucas Oil Stadium during DCI's Celebration Events. General Information
Presenting Sponsor: The DCI Southwestern Championship is presented by Fred J. Miller.
Bag Policy: The Alamodome will have a clear bag policy in effect for this event, restricting the size and style bags that will be permitted within the venue. View additional information.
Parking:
Spectator Parking – Spectator parking will be located in Lot C. ADA parking will be located in Lot A, please enter at the South end of the parking lot.
Group Bus Parking – Group bus parking will be located in Lot B for $65 per bus.
Spectator Entrances:
Entrance – Spectator entry will be located at North Gates #1 & #2 and South Gate #7.
Spectator Re-Entry – Spectator re-entry will be located at North Gates #1 & #2 and South Gate #7 and will require a ticket and wristband.
Concessions: Concessions will be available on the East concourse.
Souvenirs: The DCI Festival Marketplace will be located on the East concourse.

events.notesGeneral:
Parking: Event parking is available in the Blue Lot, Summerhill, and Grey Lots surrounding of Center Parc Stadium. Parking lots will open at 12:00 p.m. on Saturday, July 27. Prepurchase your parking online at app.parkmobile.io/venues/center-parc-stadium/events/217082. Parking can be purchased on site as well, both cash & card will be accepted.

 

Group Parking: School busses are encouraged to purchase their event parking in the Blue Lot. Prepurchase your parking online at app.parkmobile.io/venues/center-parc-stadium/events/217082.

 

Clear Bag Policy: Center Parc Credit Union Stadium will have a clear bag policy in effect for this event, restricting the size and style bags that will be permitted within the venue. View additional information. Bag valet will be available at a $5 charge near the entry gates.

 

Gate Information: Attendees must enter at Gate 8. Those looking to leave and re-enter the Venue must do so at Gate 7, where they will receive a wristband. Those re-entering the venue will be required to go through security screening at Gate 8 again.

 

Concessions: Stadium concessionaires will be open on the 100, 200, 300 & 400 level concourses.
